translation.name: Dillꞌ wen dillꞌ   Kob C̱he   Jesucrístonaꞌ

book.name: 1 Corintios
book.title: Kart nech daa bzej Páblona' na' bseḻeen lao beṉ'ka' nonḻilall' Jesucrístona' yell Coríntona'

content: Kat' tole de to dii zed c̱hele kon sto beena' nakle txen nonḻilall'le Crístona', bi chiyaḻ' shajle lao beṉ'ka' bi nonḻilall' Crístona' kwenc̱he gongake' yeḻ' josc̱his c̱helena', san ḻi shaj lao beṉ'ka' nak lall' na' Chioza' kwenc̱he gongake' yeḻ' josc̱his c̱helena'.
¿Abi ṉezile wllin lla le' nakle lall' na' Chioza' gonle yeḻ' josc̱his c̱he beṉ' yell-lioki? Na' shi len' gonle yeḻ' josc̱his c̱he'ka', ḻekzka' wak gonle yeḻ' josc̱his c̱he bizə diido'ka' chak ṉaa.
¿Abi ṉezile ax̱t anjlka' goncho yeḻ' josc̱his c̱he'ka'? Na' shi goncho yeḻ' josc̱his c̱he anjlka', ¿abi gak goncho yeḻ' josc̱his c̱he diiki chak ṉaa zoacho yell-lioni?
Na' shi le' chakdiḻ-len ljwell-le ni c̱he biz diika' chak c̱hele, ¿berac̱he chajzle lao josc̱hiska' beṉ'ka' bi nonḻilall'gake' Crístona', beṉ'ka' bibi zakii ladjlena'?
Nia' le' ka' kwenc̱he yido'latile. ¿Aniga tlish'le bi nteyi kwenc̱he gak gonle yeḻ' josc̱his c̱he beṉ'ka' nonḻilall'lenle Crístona'?
Latjin dii gonlen ladjle na'z, ba zejzle zjtaole xya c̱he ljwell-le lao josc̱hiska' bi nonḻilall' Crístona'.
Na' daa chao xya c̱he ljwell-le chli'n bi nsa' c̱hele wen. ¿Bic̱he ki chonxenlall'le yog' dii choni beṉ' le', wa ki chonle ka'z kat' no chzi' chban bi de c̱hele?
Per le'lə, lwaa dii gonle ka', dii zan dii choni ljwell-le na' chizi' chibantezle c̱he ljwell-le.

¿Abi ṉezile beṉ'ka' bi chon wen aga willingake' gana' zoa Chioza' chṉabi'e? Bi siye'z kwinle, ḻa' ka nak beṉ'ka' chdalen ljwellin, beṉ'ka' choe'la'o yaj yagka', beṉ'ka' bi chon banez xoolin wa noolka' bi chon banez beṉ' c̱heyin, beṉ' xejka',

beṉ' wbanka', beṉ'ka' chzelallii gat' kwe'gakile' daa de yell-lioni, beṉ' weezoka', beṉ'ka' chbell chṉe c̱he beṉ', wa beṉ'ka' chyiljlall' naklə si' kwangake' bi de c̱he beṉ', ni to beṉ'ka' chon diiki bi yillingake' gana' zoa Chioza' chṉabi'e.

Na' baḻ-le gokle ka beṉ' malki kana'. Per ṉaa Chioza' ba bix̱is biyibe' le', ba none' le' yell c̱he', na' ba biyone' le' beṉ' ḻi beṉ' shao' lawe'na' daa ba nonḻilall'le X̱ancho Jesucrístona' na' daa chon Espíritu c̱he'na' llin lo yeḻ' mban c̱helena'.
Dill' de, nan: “De latj goncho bittezə.” Ḻikzan, per aga yog' daa goncho nakan wen. Na' ḻa'kzi de latj goncho bittezə, bi chiyaḻ' we'cho latj iṉabia'n cho'.

Ṉezicho yeḻ' wawa' nakan c̱he ḻeechoni, na' ḻeechoni none'n kwenc̱he shoon yeḻ' wawa'. Per Chioza' gone' ka te c̱he c̱hopte diiki. Na' kwerp c̱hechoni aga none'n kwenc̱he nottez gat'lencho, san kwenc̱he goncho daa cheeni X̱ancho Crístona', na' X̱anchona' nak lall' nee kwerp c̱hechoni.
Na' ka bisban Chioza' X̱ancho Jesucrístona' ladj beṉ' wetka' kon yeḻ' wak c̱he'na', ka'kzan yisbane' cho' ladj beṉ' wetka'.
Ṉezile yog'cho nonḻilall'cho Crístona' chzaklebicho tkwen wej kwerp c̱he'na'. Na' biga chiyaḻ' wc̱hincho kwerp c̱hechoki nak ka tkwen wej kwerp c̱he Crístona' kwenc̱he gat'lencho noolə wdana'.
¿Abi ṉezile nottezə beṉ' gat'lene' to noolə wda, chake'ne' toz? Ḻa' Cho'a Xtill' Chioza' nan: “Beṉ'ka' c̱hop gakgake' toz kwerp.”
Per beena' chon kwine' lall' na' X̱ancho Crístona', chake'ne' toz daa yoo Espíritu c̱he'na' ḻoo yic̱hjlall'do'ena'.

Bi wc̱hinle kwerp c̱helena' gat'lenzle nottez beṉ', ḻi ikwas lao dii mala' nak ka'. Ḻa' ḻennan' chx̱iṉj chḻenchan kwerp c̱hechona' aga ka bichlə dii mal yoblə. Beena' gon to dii mal yoblə, aga bi nonan c̱he kwerp c̱he'na', san daa chon beena' chc̱hin kwerp c̱he'na' chat'lene' nottez, chx̱iṉj chḻenan do ka nake'.
¿Abi ṉezile kwerp c̱hechoni nakan lill xḻatj Espíritu Sántona', beena' bzoa Chioza' ḻoo yic̱hjlall'do'choni? Na' bi gak goncho daa nazan c̱hecho;
ḻa' Crístona' ba biya'o bizi'e cho' daa blalj xc̱hene'na' na' wite' ni c̱hecho kwenc̱he nakcho lall' na' Chioza'. Daan yog' daa gonlen kwerp c̱hechoni chiyaḻ' gonchon ka sho' Chioza' balaaṉ.
